answers.core: The CSGPolygon3D already does a very nice job of building swept polygons around paths, and the code is not small. Replicating it in a separate asset would mean significant duplication of code, and the corresponding maintenance issues later.
answers.workaround: There appears to be no way to suppress this, or easily delete it from the ArrayMesh after construction.

title: Add CSGPolygon3D option to suppress end-caps
